## Exact missing observation hook and bounded adaptation

Neither maintained 1.21.11 port has a `devClient` source set or observation
entrypoint. Production `runClient` alone cannot generate the required three-stage
receipt or drive API-only Apply. Do not claim a title screen as this acceptance.
The finite timebox was spent preparing inputs rather than adding a second probe
framework. No uncompiled probe patch is presented as working code.

at `build/fabric-roundtrip-r1/candidate.patch` (283-line helper) after parent review.

property-guarded `FabricRoundtrip.register()`. Adapt that helper into a new dev-only
1.21.11 source set/metadata with the existing port's public
`FabricLodSettings.apply(boolean, LodPreset)`; ordinary production behavior must
remain unchanged when the new property is absent. Keep the helper's initial-Off
requirement, conflict-property refusal, stable30-second settle, finite300-second
failure deadline, selected/loaded pack equality, shaders in use, no fallback,
original archive hash, full loaded-option restoration and screenshot-before-next-
Apply sequencing. The exact loaded map route is
`Iris.getCurrentPack().orElseThrow().getShaderPackOptions()` →
`getOptionSet()` plus `getOptionValues()` boolean/string getters.

For NeoForge use the same bounded stage logic in a dev-only client post-tick
subscription and call the existing actual production
`com.pp.shaderlod.ShaderLodSettings.apply(boolean, LodPreset)`; observe
`ShaderLodConfig.ENABLED/PRESET` and config snapshot instead of Fabric JSON.

filenames. Both screenshot calls must be adapted to pinned1.21.11 Minecraft
`Screenshot`/GPU texture API and compiled against actual libraries. Dimension
identifier access also changed from1.21.1; do not copy `location()` blindly.

physical F8 and keyboard/mouse are distinct unverified boundaries.

`GLFW.glfwGetWindowMonitor(window.getWindow()) != 0`, positive equal
window-framebuffer and main-target dimensions, **1920×1200 at all three stages**,
fullscreen requested and actual focus. Record native monitor ID, GL renderer/
version/backend, actual world/dimension/player camera/time/weather and shader-loaded
pack/options. Capture original → production Apply On → production Apply Off
screenshots in the same world; reject fallback/changed world/original archive
mutation, and preserve a failed receipt without automatic retry or client exit.
Keep explicit `linkedUniformReadbackPerformed=false` and `gpuTimingPerformed=false`
unless an actual typed shader consumer/readback path is implemented and executed.

# Independent Sildur Fabric 1.21.11 speed review

**No useful original-relative gain is established. Close this fixed cached Sildur 1.21.11 trial.** On costs 8.0489% more wall time per completed render than the first original, while native return drifts 32.1149% higher. The latter prevents attributing an exact causal slowdown to the candidate. Actual native rendering, helper consumption and successful Off restoration are supported; the performance hypothesis is negative. Preserve the fixed scene/preset/windows and all raw evidence rather than tune this trial into a pass.

| Measured phase | Elapsed seconds | Completed world renders | Recomputed ms/render |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Original Off | 30.000898667 | 3,318 | 9.041862166064 |
| On | 30.002551583 | 3,071 | 9.769635813416 |
| Return Off | 30.007455708 | 2,512 | 11.945643195860 |

Each value independently reproduces `1000 * elapsedSeconds / renderFrames` exactly. Total denominator is **8,901 completed world renders**, with zero recorded invalid measured frames. These are wall elapsed/completed-render metrics, not GPU timings. No alternate return-relative baseline or pooled drift correction is substituted for the original.

The actual compactor observer records full On-stage **2,593 calls, 77,575 → 77,479 commands, 95 reduced batches**: 96 removed commands, **0.1237512% of commands passed to the helper across the full stage**, including warmup. During the measured On window it records **24 calls, 282 → 282 commands, zero reduced batches**. Both Off stages/windows have zero helper calls/commands/reductions. Newer Sodium caches batches: warmup reductions can be retained and reused, but these counters count fill/compactor invocations, not repeated GPU submissions. Neither the 96 total nor the zero measured-fill reductions establishes per-frame GPU draw savings or shader-work reduction. Gate/helper execution alone is not useful speed evidence.

This run exercises successful Apply/Off return; failed Apply, Cancel, Quality and mismatched-input restoration remain untested here.
